checks.check: Run settings materially differed without reason
checks.evidence: The frozen V2 control variables specify sampling temperature 0.2 / top_p 1.0 / max_output_tokens 1200 / tools none, applied identically across conditions. The Agent-tool sub-agent backend selected in Phase 0 does not expose temperature/top_p/seed/max_tokens parameters to the orchestrator, so these could not be independently set or verified for any of the 45 generation calls. This deviation is uniform across all 45 generations (same backend, same model, same lack of parameter control for A, B, and C alike), so it is not a between-condition confound, but it is a real loss of exact reproducibility/control and is recorded as a material protocol deviation from condition-specification.md's Control variables section.

deviation_summary: Sampling-parameter control (temperature/top_p/seed/max_tokens) is not exposed by the qualified Agent-tool sub-agent backend. This is disclosed as a control-variable deviation. It does not by itself invalidate the A vs B vs C comparison (deviation is uniform across conditions), but it does mean this replication cannot claim exact frozen-sampling reproducibility, and results should be read as one stochastic sample per cell (3 reps) under an uncontrolled-but-fixed-model sampling regime rather than a temperature-pinned regime.
